2610.10770.title: AI-Mediated Self: How HCI Defines and Relates to the Self
2610.10770.paper_summary: How might AI alter how we understand and experience the self? This scoping review analyzes 102 papers to examine how the self is defined in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI), how AI-self relationships are conceptualized, and what risks emerge when AI becomes entangled with selfhood. Our synthesis makes three contributions. First, we define AI-mediated self as a conceptual umbrella that connects dispersed work across education, workplace, health, and creative practices. Second, we consolidate six framings of the self with four domains of ethical risk-agency/autonomy, identity/authorship, relational capacity, and meaning-making-into a conceptual map that provides a reusable vocabulary across contexts. Third, we introduce the Inclusion of AI-Self framework, which situates AI-self relationships along a spectrum of proximity. Together, these contributions position selfhood as a central design space in HCI.
2610.10770.paper_summary_zh: AI 如何改變我們理解和體驗自我的方式？這篇範疇回顧分析了 102 篇論文，以檢視自我在人體與計算機互動 (HCI) 領域中的定義，AI 與自我之間的關係如何被概念化，以及當 AI 與自我糾纏時出現的風險。我們的綜合分析有三個貢獻。首先，我們將 AI 媒介的自我定義為一個概念性傘，將教育、工作場所、健康和創意實踐等不同領域的研究聯繫起來。其次，我們將自我的六種框架與四個倫理風險領域——代理性/自主性、身份/創作、關係能力和意義建構——整合成一個概念地圖，提供可在不同情境中重複使用的詞彙。第三，我們引入了 AI-自我納入框架，該框架將 AI-自我關係置於一個接近度的光譜上。這些貢獻共同將自我定位為 HCI 中一個核心的設計空間。
